required_pr_review.summary: Mergeguez review evidence is the primary required PR-review source.
required_pr_review.fallback_summary: Neither self-managed nor Pullfrog evidence is accepted for normal closeout; hosted Mergeguez review is mandatory.

local_validation.summary: Workflow materialization, checksum-verified actionlint, deterministic review-only policy tests, immutable-pin checks, YAML and JSON parsing, Speculoos validation, publish-check, and git diff checks must pass for the Pullfrog pilot workflow proposal.

github_checks.summary: Read live checks at the future workflow PR exact head before merge.

self_managed.summary: Emergency fallback only; not the normal review lane.

pullfrog_review.summary: Optional exact-head comparison evidence only. Model authorization, service configuration, and the first invocation remain separate external gates and cannot satisfy the required review source.

mergeguez_review.summary: The future workflow PR requires a fresh exact-head Mergeguez review before merge.
